title: Drone: multirotor flight stack
description: A 6S flight stack to grow into a multirotor: DolphinRC F405 V3 flight controller and AM32 60A 4-in-1 ESC (one purchased stack), CNHL 1100 mAh 6S pack on an XT60 lead, RadioMaster RP1 V2 ELRS receiver on UART2. Frame, motors, props, video and GNSS are yours to add.
